sentiment: To understand is to compress: keep what matters, let the rest fall away, and trust the shape that remains.

stories.title: Can gzip be a language model?
stories.summary: A compression algorithm borrowed as a stand-in for prediction, and it works better than it should. Understanding and compression turn out to be the same gesture: hold what repeats, discard what does not.

stories.title: Attention is all you have
stories.summary: A meditation on attention as the whole mechanism, not just a component. What a system chooses to keep looking at is what it becomes.

stories.title: What Sun got wrong
stories.summary: An engineer looks back at a company that had everything and lost the thread. A reminder that the shape you trust has to be the one that actually holds.
